summary: Develop practical IT audit planning, control testing, and reporting skills. Explore the five-day intermediate course and its applied exercises.
lede: IT auditing training helps IT auditors, internal auditors, and technology risk specialists assess information systems controls. Participants practise prioritizing audit scope, testing IT general and application controls, and evaluating evidence, including transaction data analyzed in Excel. They also document conclusions and report findings with remediation ownership, linking control objectives to test procedures in work that another reviewer can follow.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for professionals who assess technology risks, test controls, or use IT audit findings to oversee system assurance and remediation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with information technology operations, internal controls, or audit work is expected. Prior experience preparing or reviewing audit evidence is useful. No programming is required. Preparation: Bring a laptop with Excel available for spreadsheet-based audit exercises. The course does not require participants to install specialist audit software.
